PawChart

A full-stack, multi-tenant SaaS platform for veterinary clinic management — appointments, medical records with dental charts, inventory, prescriptions, billing, team permissions, and analytics — with regionally tuned recurring subscriptions.

Visit the live product
Year
2025
Duration
24 weeks to v1
Our role
Domain discovery, design system, full-stack engineering
Platforms
Web · Tablet-optimised clinical views · Admin console

Context

A veterinarian-turned-founder had mapped the clinical workflow in detail but had no software team. The product needed to be credible to practising vets on day one, which meant getting the medical record model right before anything else.

The problem

Veterinary clinics still juggle paper charts, spreadsheets, messaging apps and fragmented point-of-sale tools — while international practice-management products ignore regional payment rails, local-language UX and local currencies.

Clinical records are not CRM records

Dental charts, vaccination schedules and prescription histories have strict structure and retention expectations. A generic notes field would have been unusable.

Multi-tenant isolation with shared reference data

Clinics must never see each other’s patients, while drug catalogues and breed taxonomies stay shared and centrally maintained.

Billing across seven currencies

Subscription pricing, invoices and tax display all had to be correct per region without forking the codebase.

How we built it

Row-level tenancy enforced at the query layer

Tenant scoping lives in a single data-access boundary rather than being reapplied in every handler, so an isolation bug cannot be introduced by a new endpoint.

Structured clinical schema

Dental charts and vaccination plans are typed entities with their own history, making longitudinal views and recall reminders straightforward.

Currency-aware billing layer

Prices are stored in minor units with an explicit currency, and every display path formats through one locale-aware helper.

Outcome

A cloud practice platform covering the full clinical workflow — appointments, pet medical records with dental charts, inventory, prescriptions, invoicing and real-time team coordination — with recurring subscriptions across seven regional currencies.

  • Clinics replaced paper charts, a spreadsheet and a separate booking tool with one system.
  • Real-time coordination between front desk and consult rooms via socket-backed updates.
  • Recurring subscriptions live across seven regional currencies from a single deployment.
